description:
## Problem

`README.md`'s Workspace layout table lists `gf2-core`, `gf2-coding`, `gf2-stats`, `gf2-algebra`, `gf2-kernels-simd`, `gf2-kernels-hip`, and `proofs/`, but not `gf2-sim` — even though the file carries a `gf2-sim` coverage badge at `README.md:7` and the crate owns the CPU/GPU simulation pipeline, the campaign runners, and the OSD campaign protocol. A reader of the workspace table cannot discover the crate.

Recorded during epic b7157be6 as a deferred doc-review advisory (NOTE-03) and classified there as repo hygiene outside that epic's scope.

The same advisory paired this with a claim that `AGENTS.md:48`'s `@/issue/ec530af9` address does not resolve. That half is withdrawn: the issue exists, is `done`, and has its design doc linked; `@/issue/<short-id>` is simply not dereferenceable through `jit item show` for any issue, including the established `crates/gf2-core/src/alg/rref.rs:599` idiom. No AGENTS.md change is wanted.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The workspace layout table in `README.md` carries a `gf2-sim` row describing the crate's purpose, consistent in style with the surrounding rows.
- [hard] REQ-02: The row's description matches what the crate actually owns, checked against `crates/gf2-sim/src/lib.rs` and `AGENTS.md`.
title: Workspace README omits the gf2-sim crate from its layout table
